title: Grateful Dead Live at Campolindo High School on 1969-05-16
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough high‑school audience tape of an uninspired early‑'69 show; sound is surprisingly decent for the source but the performance falls flat.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a low‑budget auditorium cassette that, given its limitations, offers a fairly clear glimpse of the band in a teenage gym. Musically the set is widely regarded as dull and poorly organized, with only a few moments like “School Girl” and “Lovelight” standing out while songs such as “Hard to Handle” are described as painfully bad.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show poorly (1‑2 stars) and note only modest recording quality; a weighted average of show (≈2/5) and recording (≈3/5) yields ~2.3 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded on a high‑school auditorium cassette; limited fidelity, tape hiss and a vintage ’65‑style tone, but surprisingly clear for an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The gig feels disjointed and uninspired, typical of an early‑'69 rehearsal‑type show in a gym setting, lacking the energy and cohesion of later Dead concerts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: No specific guitar praise; reviewers note he was serious but not particularly inspired.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned talking with Jerry about music; no distinct performance comment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is highlighted for its soulful playing despite the overall roughness.
